reason: Elements cleanup, cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 001-tokens-theming-followups (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). (1) ki-indicator holds the bound its contract already declared. The catalog rejects more than 20 positions (the @maximum of count and current), but markup and scripts reach the element without the catalog and one dot renders per position: count="20000" built 20,001 nodes. The component now renders at most 20 positions, reading a single constant that a browser test pins to the maximum the generated manifest declares. A count above 20 renders 20 and exposes "<label>, <current> / 20"; a count from 0 to 20 is untouched. The only surface delta is the description of count on @kimen/elements, which now states that at most 20 positions render; type, default, minimum and maximum are unchanged. (2) Dead code. The declared class of ki-option loses two getters, optionValue and optionDisabled: nothing in the library read them (the owning ki-select derives both from the option's attributes), they were never documented, and they reached the declaration surface only because the class did not mark them private. The gate classifies the changed class signature as MAJOR, as the cumulative delta already was. ki-option.value is no longer declared mutable, which only described writes from inside the component and there are none; the property is assigned from outside exactly as before. (3) One definition of the button surface. ki-icon-button.css repeated the variant x tone x state rules of ki-button.css with the prefix changed, fed by a twin token family: 188 of the 198 --ki-icon-button-* tokens resolved to the value of the same-named --ki-button-* token in all four theme x scheme compositions, material3 overrides included. Both components now load one shared sheet (ki-button.surface.css) fed by the --ki-button-* tokens, and ki-icon-button keeps as its own only the ten tokens that differ: --ki-icon-button-{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}-size and -icon-size. The other 188 published names are gone from @kimen/tokens, 69 of them also as material3 overrides: the matrix {variant}-{tone}-{state}-{bg,fg,border} with its active and disabled cells, the per-variant shadows, overlays and bevels, {size}-radius, border-width, backdrop-blur and the focus-ring quartet. Each has the same-named --ki-button-* token as its replacement, with the same resolved value in every composition; to style icon buttons apart from buttons the button token is set on the element (ki-icon-button { --ki-button-md-radius: ... }). None of the 188 exists in the 0.0.0 baseline (ki-icon-button postdates it), so the gate records no removal: relative to the baseline they are additions that are no longer made. The cssProperties the manifest records ki-icon-button as consuming change accordingly, from its twin family to the --ki-button-* tokens of the shared sheet plus its own ten; ki-button consumes the same 177 --ki-button-* tokens as before and stops listing the semantic --ki-transparent-inverse, which only fed overlay resets that nothing read. Rendering is unchanged: computed paint and geometry of every node of the 29 galleries are identical before and after in the four compositions at rest, hover and pressed. The 80 --ki-button-* tokens that no stylesheet consumes (the forty-five {variant}-{tone}-active-{bg,fg,border} cells and five {variant}-active-shadow tokens that declaration 010 left published, and the thirty {variant}-{success,danger}-disabled-{bg,fg,border} cells) stay published. They are in the 0.0.0 baseline without deprecation metadata, and the gate rejects their removal until a deprecation has shipped for one minor. Zero removals relative to the baseline, no root growth. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
